course_name_original: Protection of industrial property and copyright
course_name_en: Protection of industrial property and copyright

learning_outcomes.text: Understand the fundamental concepts of industrial property and copyright.
Analyze the legal protections available for inventions, trademarks, and creative works
Assess the implications of infringement and the enforcement of intellectual property rights.

syllabus_topics: Definition and types of intellectual property
Patents: Definition, types, and criteria for patentability
Trademarks: Definition, registration process, and protection
Definition and types of works protected by copyright
Overview of major international treaties (e.g., TRIPS, Berne Convention)
The role of WIPO and other international organizations
assessment_rules: The condition for passing the course is to achieve all the required learning outcomes specified for the course.
bibliography: G. Michniewicz, Ochrona własności intelektualnej, Warszawa 2022
P. Goldstein, Copyright Law: Essential Cases and Materials, 2024
